title: Romanian F-16s Destroy Explosive-Laden Naval Drone Near Neptun Deep Gas Platform; President Dan Blames Russia's 'Escalating Campaign'
detail: Romania's Coast Guard was alerted around 06:28 local time on August 20, 2026 by a commercial vessel that spotted a drifting maritime drone several hundred meters from the offshore facilities at the Neptun Deep gas project, roughly 80 nautical miles east of Constanța in Romania's Black Sea exclusive economic zone. Two Romanian F-16 fighter jets were scrambled and, in the Romanian Air Force's first cannon kill and first maritime-drone engagement, used onboard cannon fire to destroy the explosive-laden drone to protect the several hundred workers on site and secure the critical gas infrastructure. Romanian President Nicușor Dan blamed Russia directly, describing the incident as part of an "escalating campaign of threats" against the European Union. The episode extends a pattern this tracker has tracked since the August 16 Spanish F/A-18 drone shootdown near Galați: repeated Russian-attributed drone incursions testing NATO's eastern flank, reinforcing the alliance's pivot toward European-led air and maritime defense of allied territory and critical infrastructure even as the Pentagon's Europe force-posture review continues.

media.caption: Maritime drone destroyed by Romanian F-16s near the Neptun Deep gas platform in the Black Sea
